title.rendered: Notice of Public Hearing on 2025-26 Budget – June 2, 2025

content.rendered:
A public meeting of the Sherwood School District Board of Directors will be held on June 2, 2025 at 6:00 p.m. in the District Office Board Room, located at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140. The purpose of this meeting is to discuss the budget for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2025, as approved by the Sherwood School District 88J Budget Committee. 

A copy of the budget may be inspected or obtained at the Sherwood School District’s District Office, 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140 between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m., or at the link below.

This budget is for an annual budget period.
